name: Vercel eve
desc: Framework for building, running and scaling background coding agents.
desc_zh: 用于构建、运行和扩展后台编程智能体的开源框架。
solves: A coding agent that works on one laptop falls over at scale; the framework handles running many of them and scaling out.
solves_zh: 在一台笔记本上能跑的编程智能体一上量就撑不住；这个框架负责把许多个跑起来并横向扩展。
best_for: You have one working agent and need to run hundreds of them on demand.
best_for_zh: 手上有一个能用的智能体，需要按需同时跑几百个。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — vercel.com/changelog directory）。 Public preview at launch. No dedicated product site was found, so the announcement page is used as the entry point. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「eve」，加上厂商名以便辨认。首页从更新日志文章换成官方文档页（vercel.com/docs/frameworks/agents/eve，标题「eve on Vercel」）。 首次公开日期来源：https://vercel.com/changelog/introducing-eve-an-open-source-agent-framework
